newsitem.title: UK: Euro raw cotton market finds mill buyers selective.
newsitem.headline: Euro raw cotton market finds mill buyers selective.

text.p: Reports cite good actvity in cotton yarn in European markets but this does not seem to have bouyed trading volume in raw cotton.

Mill buyers again seemed unwilling to pay firm prices sought by the trade, even though they now apparently accept that Central Asian styles may be tight as summer progresses and that alternatives will have to be sought when planning new purchases.
Italians users mentioned West African and Indian descriptions together with Greek new crop styles slightly further forward.
Some buying as been stimulated partly by the weaker dollar.
Mills in France have taken advantage of the benefit to their replacement costs to buy selected supply including West African and Central Asians for August.
